# Incident review: storage firmware rollout delayed (Nov 3)

Decision: retire maintenance_override. Long jobs must checkpoint before windows; one +20 min extension per window remains available through the budget controller.
Action items: remove override from runbooks (done), revoke access (in progress), monitor usage.
